description: Read-only sync of confirmed BountyEscrow events (Funded, Submitted, Paid, Refunded) on Base Sepolia (6 confirmations required). Never holds keys or sends transactions. Unseals the winning submission's deliverable ONLY once a confirmed Paid event matches both the job id and ref = keccak256(bounty_id).
